verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is a document-parsing/extraction service that exposes its own capabilities as an MCP server (mcp.llamaindex.ai/mcp) for other agents to call; it is not itself an agent host that plugs in and orchestrates external MCP servers' tools. The evidence pack shows only the server-provider role (docs-8, docs-16, docs-21, docs-27, probe-4), which is the wrong axis for this story.
